name: Glowing Mushroom City
description: A bustling city at twilight composed of luminous mushroom towers, with glowing caps that emit soft melodies and pathways of mycelium that light up with each step.
prompt: Night cityscape of towering mushrooms with bioluminescent caps, streets of glowing mycelium, gentle music audible, ambient neon blues, hyperrealistic, no text, immersive fantasy urban landscape.
caption: Enter the mushroom metropolis where towers sing and streets glow—nature builds a city of its own.
